quote: gf=high, vegan=ask
method: all four claims checked against the FMGF listing, four pages of TripAdvisor reviews, and the shop's own /, /gallette, /concept and /menu pages
note: No claim is false; two are supported on the page cited and two need repointing (one to FMGF, one to /gallette). gf=high is exactly the right tier and the record is unusually well calibrated for it — it leads with the non-dedicated warning rather than the 100%-buckwheat headline, which is the correct order of information for a celiac. Two additions worth making. (1) The shop's own Japanese menu never uses the word グルテン at all, so a diner cannot self-serve from the menu card and must speak to the chef — one FMGF reviewer says exactly this. (2) A wheat trap the record does not flag: the dinner appetiser 「蕎麦チップスとそば味噌」 contains miso of unstated type, and Japanese miso is frequently 麦味噌 or wheat-koji based. VEGAN LABEL: vegan=ask is defensible only as 'you will have to ask' — no source names a vegan item, and every galette on the published menu carries egg, cheese, butter, cream, ham, duck, pork or salmon, with dessert galettes on butter and milk ice cream. The record also has no vegan_cross_contact claim at all; if the tier stays, it should at least say that no vegan option is published.
